description:
State document, in Arabic script. Six lines of a faded petition, or report, the top four lines are extremely effaced. Mentions probably a man of the countryside "al-rajul al-rīf". The last line also contains the raʾy clause: "انعاما واحسانا ولسيدنا الارا عـ".

On recto Hebrew poem
description_he: מסמך ערבי דהוי מאוד — נדרשת בדיקה. בצד הפנים פיוט עברי.
